about: EMT cases simulated by ngspice (scripts/oracle/emt_spice.py) and by the engine (engine/crates/ps-study/tests/emt.rs, tests/emt.test.mjs). `engine` holds what the circuit shares with the engine by design: the breaker pole resistance and every node's conductance to earth, p.u. on the system base. The engine runs with instantSwitching, as SPICE switches act at their times, and with a step of `dtUs`: an instant switching excites ringing of several kilohertz, which the trapezoidal rule resolves to a few 1e-3 of crest at 1 µs (its error falls with the square of the step). A travelling wave's front is a jump, which the rule spreads over one step, so near fronts the error falls only in proportion to the step: the line energisation steps 0.25 µs. Events lie off the sampling grid, so no sample falls on a travelling wave's front, where a waveform has two values. SPICE's switches move from open to closed over `switchRampUs`, a tenth of the engine's step, so they act within 0.1 µs of the engine's.
